# United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)

> The official USMLE platform providing comprehensive information on the three-step medical licensing examination process, exam administration, preparation resources, and candidate support.

USMLE is administered by the National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME) in partnership with the Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB). The site serves as the primary resource for medical students and international medical graduates pursuing licensure in the United States.

## Key Topics

- USMLE (United States Medical Licensing Examination)
- Step 1
- Step 2 CK
- Step 3
- NBME (National Board of Medical Examiners)
- FSMB (Federation of State Medical Boards)
- Prometric (test administration)
- Exam preparation
- Test accommodations (ADA)
- Exam security and fairness
- Exam day procedures
- Medical licensing
- Score interpretation
- Scheduling and registration
- Exam resources and bulletin

## USMLE Step Exams

- [Step 1](https://www.usmle.org/step-exams/step-1): Step 1 exam overview with scheduling, eligibility, and preparation info
- [Step 2 CK](https://www.usmle.org/step-exams/step-2-ck): Step 2 CK exam overview with scheduling, eligibility, and preparation
- [Step 3](https://www.usmle.org/step-exams/step-3): Step 3 exam overview with scheduling, eligibility, and preparation info

## Exam Day Procedures & Conduct

- [Exam Day Information](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/exam-day-information): Exam day checklist, test center procedures, and conduct rules
- [Admission to the Test](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/exam-day-information/admission-test): Check-in and security procedures for test center admission
- [Starting and Completing the Test](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/exam-day-information/starting-and-completing-test): Rules for starting/completing exams and technical problem procedures
- [Break Time](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/exam-day-information/break-time): Break time rules and policies during USMLE exam sessions
- [Personal Belongings](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/exam-day-information/personal-belongings): Policy on prohibited personal items and storage at test centers

## Exam Security & Violations

- [Exam Security & Fairness](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/exam-security-fairness): USMLE security violations, cheating prevention, and STOPit reporting
- [Examples of Security Violations](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/exam-security-fairness/examples-security-violations): Comprehensive list of USMLE cheating and irregular behavior violations
- [Investigation Process](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/exam-security-fairness/investigation-process): USMLE security violation investigation and enforcement procedures

## Exam Resources & Information

- [Exam Resources](https://www.usmle.org/exam-resources): Comprehensive exam resources including USMLE Bulletin of Information
- [USMLE Updates & Research](https://www.usmle.org/usmle-updates-research): Performance data, score interpretation guidelines, and USMLE research
- [Recent Announcements](https://www.usmle.org/announcements): Recent USMLE announcements on exam updates and policy changes

## Program Overview & Support

- [Home](https://www.usmle.org): Main USMLE homepage covering Step 1, Step 2 CK, and Step 3 exams
- [About the USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/about-usmle): Overview of USMLE program, medical licensing authorities, and exam purpose
- [Contact Us](https://www.usmle.org/contact-us): Contact information for USMLE, NBME, and FSMB organizations

## Accommodations & Registration

- [Test Accommodations](https://www.usmle.org/what-to-know/test-accommodations): ADA test accommodations request process for USMLE Step exams
- [Reschedule an Exam](https://www.usmle.org/reschedule-exam): Instructions for rescheduling USMLE exams via Prometric

## Optional

- [USMLE Email Sign Up](https://info.usmle.org/usmle-email-sign-up.html): Newsletter signup for USMLE program updates and information
